title: GSEA running enrichment
background: Gene Set Enrichment Analysis — the running enrichment-score curve with leading-edge genes and NES / p / FDR (Subramanian et al. 2005). Runs against a license-clean GO library (or a pasted set) via gseapy.prerank, with blitzgsea and an in-house weighted-KS fallback selectable.

references.title: Gene set enrichment analysis: a knowledge-based approach for interpreting genome-wide expression profiles
references.authors: Subramanian A, Tamayo P, Mootha VK, et al.
references.note: The GSEA method this skill implements.

references.title: GSEApy: gene set enrichment analysis in Python
references.authors: Fang Z, Liu X, Peltz G

references.title: blitzGSEA — fast prerank GSEA with Loess p-value estimation
references.note: Opt-in alternate engine for finer p-values on small libraries.

catalog.summary: Gene Set Enrichment Analysis — running enrichment-score curve with leading-edge hits + NES/p/FDR. Runs against the license-clean GO library (or a pasted set) via gseapy.prerank / blitzgsea, with an in-house weighted-KS fallback.
